mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO ai_feedback ( ai_decision_id, stock_code, evaluation_type, base_price, evaluated_price, highest_price, lowest_price, return_rate, market_return_rate, excess_return_rate, target_reached, stop_loss_reached, success, feedback_summary, evaluated_at ) VALUES ( #{aiDecisionId}, #{stockCode}, #{evaluationType}, #{basePrice}, #{evaluatedPrice}, #{highestPrice}, #{lowestPrice}, #{returnRate}, #{marketReturnRate}, #{excessReturnRate}, #{targetReached}, #{stopLossReached}, #{success}, #{feedbackSummary}, NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT id, ai_decision_id, stock_code, evaluation_type, base_price, evaluated_price, highest_price, lowest_price, return_rate, market_return_rate, excess_return_rate, target_reached, stop_loss_reached, success, feedback_summary, evaluated_at FROM ai_feedback WHERE ai_decision_id = #{aiDecisionId} ORDER BY evaluated_at DESC

SELECT id, ai_decision_id, stock_code, evaluation_type, base_price, evaluated_price, highest_price, lowest_price, return_rate, market_return_rate, excess_return_rate, target_reached, stop_loss_reached, success, feedback_summary, evaluated_at FROM ai_feedback WHERE stock_code = #{stockCode} ORDER BY evaluated_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT id, ai_decision_id, stock_code, evaluation_type, base_price, evaluated_price, highest_price, lowest_price, return_rate, market_return_rate, excess_return_rate, target_reached, stop_loss_reached, success, feedback_summary, evaluated_at FROM ai_feedback WHERE ai_decision_id = #{aiDecisionId} AND evaluation_type = #{evaluationType} LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN success = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS success_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN target_reached = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS target_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN stop_loss_reached = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stop_loss_cnt, AVG(return_rate) AS avg_return, MAX(return_rate) AS max_return, MIN(return_rate) AS min_return FROM ai_feedback WHERE evaluation_type = 'HOLDING_END' AND evaluated_at >= #{from} AND evaluated_at < DATE_ADD(#{to}, INTERVAL 1 DAY)

SELECT id, ai_decision_id, stock_code, evaluation_type, base_price, evaluated_price, highest_price, lowest_price, return_rate, market_return_rate, excess_return_rate, target_reached, stop_loss_reached, success, feedback_summary, evaluated_at FROM ai_feedback WHERE evaluation_type = 'HOLDING_END' AND evaluated_at >= #{from} AND evaluated_at < #{to} ORDER BY evaluated_at ASC
